docs.title: PlayLingo Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to PlayLingo documentation — a small offline translation toolkit for games.

  • Python package: playlingo (translate, subtitles, CLI)
  • .NET library: PlayLingo (Translator, Subtitles, CLI)

See the Usage page for quick examples and the Changelog for release notes.

docs.title: Python
docs.text:
Install dependencies and run tests:

python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
pytest

Example:

from playlingo import translate
from playlingo.subtitles import translate_subtitles

print(translate("hello", src="en", dest="tr"))

docs.title: .NET
docs.text:
Build and test:

# build
dotnet build src/PlayLingo

# test
dotnet test tests/PlayLingo.Tests

CLI example (translate SRT):

dotnet run --project src/PlayLingo -- translate-srt --input in.srt --output out.srt --src en --dest tr
